_note: BOSS ORDNANCE - one signature firing cue per boss. Mike, 2026-09-12: 'proper boss projectile
noises for each one that we have'.
Today every ship boss fires through _shipShot and they all sound alike, which is why a Rime
Wall volley and a Magma Ward volley read as the same event. Each cue below is written to the
boss's OWN element so the player can hear which boss is shooting without looking.
Keyed bossfire_<kind> against the nine STAGES[].boss kinds, measured off the table:
⚠ ALL SHORT. A boss fires a lot, and a long cue stacks into mud - which is the mechanism
behind Mike's 'beep beep beep with all these bosses' (enemyShoot, once per BULLET, no
throttle). The sound is only half that fix; the throttle is the other half.

sounds.prompt: A heavy helicopter gunship cannon firing one round. Deep percussive thump with a hard metallic snap on the front and a short mechanical clack. Immediate, dry, no reverb, no music. Retro arcade video game heavy weapon shot.

A gout of molten fire launched from a cannon. A sharp igniting crack followed by a thick roaring whoosh of flame that cuts off fast. Dry and close, no reverb, no music. Retro arcade video game fire weapon shot.

A spear of ice fired from a crystal cannon. A bright glassy shattering crack with a cold ringing shimmer trailing briefly behind it. Crisp and high. Dry, no reverb, no music. Retro arcade video game ice weapon shot.

A bolt of lightning discharged from a coil. A vicious electric snap and zap with crackling static, instant and violent, gone immediately. Dry, no reverb, no music. Retro arcade video game electric weapon shot.

An alien energy weapon firing. A warped synthetic pulse with a metallic wobble and an eerie descending whine, otherworldly and cold. Sharp start. Dry, no reverb, no music. Retro arcade video game alien weapon shot.

A missile launching from a warship bay. A hard percussive launch thud followed immediately by a rushing rocket hiss that fades quickly. Dry and close, no reverb, no music. Retro arcade video game missile launch.
A blob of corrosive acid spat under pressure. A wet bursting splat with a hissing acidic fizz, thick and slimy, cutting off fast. Dry, no reverb, no music. Retro arcade video game toxic weapon shot.

A grotesque organic creature launching a living projectile. A fleshy wet snap with a low guttural growl underneath and a brief squelching hiss. Sharp start, dry, no reverb, no music. Retro arcade video game monster attack.

A high energy fusion cannon discharging. A bright charged snap opening into a surging synthetic energy beam pulse with a watery shimmer, powerful and clean. Immediate attack. Dry, no reverb, no music. Retro arcade video game plasma cannon shot.
